ValidationRule.description: Validates mandatory fields for Channel Partner Leads
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(LeadSource, 'Channel Partner'), OR( ISBLANK(CP_ID__c), ISBLANK(CP_Company__c), ISBLANK(CP_Email__c), ISBLANK(Project__c), ISBLANK(LastName) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Channel Partner leads, CP ID, CP Company, CP Email, Project, and Customer Name (Last Name) are required.
